description: Manage Salesforce org lifecycles through the sf CLI; flags takes every documented flag of each command by its CLI name and the plugin sets --target-org, --target-dev-hub, --async, --wait, --poll-interval and --no-prompt itself. Operations: list (sf org list: every org the CLI knows, grouped as devHubs, nonScratchOrgs, sandboxes, scratchOrgs and other; flags all, clean, verbose, skip-connection-status); display (sf org display for a bound org: id, username, alias, instanceUrl, apiVersion, connectedStatus, and for a scratch org status, expirationDate, edition, orgName and devHubId; never the access token, password or SFDX auth URL); open (sf org open: opens the org in this machine's browser, or with url-only returns a single-use frontdoor link; flags path, source-file, browser, private, api-version); create_scratch (sf org create scratch --async from a bound Dev Hub; definition-file or an inline definition object, edition, snapshot, source-org, duration-days, alias, username, name, description, admin-email, release, track-source, no-namespace, no-ancestors, set-default, api-version, and client-id with the client secret from the vault secret named in connected_app_secret); resume_scratch (sf org resume scratch --wait 0 with job-id or use-most-recent: ready false while the org is New or Creating; when ready the CLI authorizes it and the plugin binds it, with alias and make_default); delete_scratch (sf org delete scratch for a bound scratch org, then unbinds it); create_sandbox and clone_sandbox (sf org create sandbox --async on a bound production org: name, license-type for a new sandbox or source-sandbox-name / source-id for a clone, definition-file, alias, set-default, no-track-source); refresh_sandbox (sf org refresh sandbox --async: name, source-sandbox-name or source-id, definition-file, no-auto-activate); resume_sandbox (sf org resume sandbox --wait 0 with name, job-id or use-most-recent: ready false until the SandboxProcess is Completed, then the CLI logs in and the plugin binds the sandbox); sandbox_status (Tooling query of SandboxProcess for sandbox_name: Status, CopyProgress, LicenseType, SandboxOrganization and dates, newest first); delete_sandbox (sf org delete sandbox for a bound sandbox the CLI created, then unbinds it). A Dev Hub defaults to the only bound Dev Hub, else the default org when it is one. Org limits, including DailyScratchOrgs and ActiveScratchOrgs, are rest_resources operation limits with org naming the Dev Hub. Returns job_id/status queued.
embedding_description: Create, track, open and delete Salesforce scratch orgs from a Dev Hub, and create, clone, refresh, check and delete sandboxes from a production org, through the Salesforce CLI. New orgs are connected to this solet once ready. Also lists every org the CLI knows and shows an org's details or a one-time login link.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Queued dispatch: job_id and status. Completion always has operation, and org and org_id for the org it ran against (not for list). list: devHubs, nonScratchOrgs, sandboxes, scratchOrgs and other, each row cut to alias, username, orgId, instanceUrl, loginUrl, isDevHub, isSandbox, isScratch, connectedStatus, defaultMarker, expirationDate, status, orgName, edition, isExpired, namespace and dates. display: org_display. open: opened true, or url and url_note. create_scratch: job_id (the ScratchOrgInfo id), scratch_org_info (Id, Status, ScratchOrg, SignupUsername, LoginUrl, ExpirationDate, Edition, OrgName, DurationDays, ErrorCode...), warnings and next. resume_scratch: ready; when false message and actions; when true scratch_org_info and binding. create_sandbox, clone_sandbox, refresh_sandbox: sandbox_process (Id, Status, SandboxName, SandboxInfoId, LicenseType, CopyProgress, SandboxOrganization...) and next. resume_sandbox: ready, sandbox_process (with Message while not ready) and binding when ready. sandbox_status: status, sandbox_processes and latest. delete_scratch, delete_sandbox: deleted, cli_result, binding_removed, secrets_deleted and default_org.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: A create only submits the request: relay next and resume later; a scratch org takes minutes and a sandbox can take hours. When ready is true, give the new org's alias. A url logs in once: hand it to the operator once and do not repeat it. A delete removes the org at Salesforce and unbinds it; it cannot be undone.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Run an org lifecycle command through the sf CLI with the bound user's Salesforce permissions.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: sf.invalid_params: unknown operation, an undocumented or plugin-set flag (the message names the reason), a wrong flag type or choice, a missing one-of flag (job-id or use-most-recent; name, job-id or use-most-recent; source-sandbox-name or source-id), definition with the definition-file flag or on another operation, client-id without connected_app_secret, or a malformed sandbox_name. sf.unknown_org: org matches no bound org, or no Dev Hub can be chosen (the message lists them). sf.auth_failed: the CLI has no usable session for the org. sf.import_path_refused: a definition or source file lies outside the saved path addresses. sf.api_error: the CLI refused or failed; the message carries the CLI's error name, its message and its recommended next step as received.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: Check list_orgs for the org and Dev Hub. A scratch org create needs a Dev Hub user with scratch org permissions and free DailyScratchOrgs and ActiveScratchOrgs (rest_resources limits on the Dev Hub). Sandbox work needs a production org with a free sandbox license and Manage Sandboxes; delete_sandbox works only for sandboxes the CLI created. Resume operations are safe to repeat.
